analytics.note: Placeholders live in shared/seo.json: ga4MeasurementId (example G-XXXXXXXXXX; empty or all-X does not load), metaPixelId (digits only; empty does not load), googleSiteVerification (empty does not print the meta tag). GA4 and the pixel load only after the visitor accepts the consent banner. Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied in index.html and updates to granted on accept. The choice is stored in localStorage under latamleap.consent. referral_submit is a GA4 key event: mark it in Admin when the property exists. referral_link_landing, referral_share_click and referral_section_view stay regular events.
